about: Binder eval set (RAMAN-TASK R6 gate: expected item in top-3 for >= 80%; zero false binds on the cadence trap). `accept` lists lowercase substrings matched against the slug with 'github.com/' removed; any match counts. Expected items were chosen from canonical tools present in the catalog on 2026-11-09, before running the Binder, and are not tuned to its output. Needs avoid tool names unless a user would name the system (Slack, Notion, ...).

items.need: Post a message to a team Slack channel when a job finishes
Run read-only SQL queries against a PostgreSQL database and inspect its schema
Create GitHub issues and open pull requests on a repository
Automate a real web browser: open pages, click buttons and fill in forms
Search the web for current information and return result links
Fetch a web page and convert its content to clean markdown
Read and update pages in a Notion workspace
Create Stripe customers and payment links
Look up recent error events and stack traces in Sentry
Create and update issues in Linear
Append rows to a Google Sheets spreadsheet and read ranges back
Send a transactional email to a customer from code
Search Apollo for people at a company and enrich their contact details
Read, write and list files in allowed local directories
Deploy a project to Vercel and check deployment logs
Manage a Supabase project: run SQL, apply migrations and list tables
Generate an image from a text prompt
Transcribe an audio recording to text
Create a Word .docx document with headings and tables
Extract text and tables from PDF files
Inspect pods and deployments in a Kubernetes cluster
Search and create tickets in Jira
Read frames and components from a Figma design file
Manage pull requests on GitHub
Run a data-sync script automatically every 30 minutes without anyone present
items.note: FRAMEWORK §3: no catalog item here runs as a scheduler on a scheduled host; a bind is a false bind. Retrieval-only mode skips this item.
